steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Earth has four main layers: crust, mantle, outer core and inner core

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The crust is thin (5-70 km) and made of solid rock; continental crust is granitic, oceanic crust is basaltic

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The mantle is the thickest layer (~2,900 km); the upper mantle is solid but the asthenosphere is partially molten and can flow slowly

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The outer core is liquid iron and nickel; it generates Earth's magnetic field through convection currents

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Q: Name the four main layers of the Earth from the surface inward. | Q: How do seismic waves provide evidence for Earth's internal structure? | Q: Why is the inner core solid despite temperatures of ~5,500 degrees C?

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Seismic wave behaviour is the key evidence for internal structure S-wave shadow zone proves the outer core is liquid Continental vs oceanic crust: density and composition differences drive plate tectonics The lithosphere includes BOTH crust and uppermost mantle, not just the crust
